regression.model: Orthogonal directional-clip rows map the receiver plane into shadow-UV depth gradients. Compare each PCF tap at its plane depth with a conservative one-texel comparison-filter support bound. Terrain uses the oriented triangle-plane normal, while shading retains its own smooth/spectral normal. Caster depth remains unbiased for the existing canonical metric oracle.
regression.resource_change: None: same atlas, geometry stream, bind groups, passes, tier-selected tap count and explicit normal bias. Only receiver arithmetic changes; disabled effects retain their existing zero-work path.
